title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
abstract: arXiv:2610.36980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. translated_title: AutoVend：基于长周期自动售货机运营的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正在将网络上的智能体中介商务从为消费者购物扩展到为卖家经营业务。在在线到线下（O2O）商务中，决策通过网络平台发布，但需要通过成本高昂的物理执行来实现。评估此类智能体需要超越单笔交易，考察在线做出的决策能否转化为持续的经济回报。我们提出了AutoVend，这是一个基准测试，其中一个LLM智能体通过基于网络的运营界面管理分布在五种站点类型中的20台自动售货机，为期180个模拟日。其基于真实数据的模拟器结合了共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期以及经常性运营成本等要素。我们评估了五个LLM智能体，并将其与基于规则的库存控制基线进行比较，诊断它们的站点协调能力、执行能力以及随时间推移的表现。在被评估的五个LLM智能体中，有四个表现不及基线……
tldr: AutoVend是一个长周期基准测试，让LLM智能体通过网络界面管理分布在五类站点的20台自动售货机180个模拟日，评估其O2O商务决策能否转化为持续经济回报，结果显示五个智能体中有四个不敌基于规则的库存控制基线。
en_tdlr: AutoVend is a long-horizon benchmark in which an LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types via a web-based interface for 180 simulated days, evaluating whether online O2O decisions translate into sustained economic returns—finding that four of the five evaluated LLM agents fall short of a rule-based inventory-control baseline.
